title: 3rd Floor Modern, Spacious Private Room & Bath
description:
Enjoy your stay in this modern, spacious, and clean private room with private bath. 

This comfortable unit has ample room for relaxing and includes a queen bed, a loveseat, mini fridge, and a workstation with adjustable height which is ideal for professionals, travelers, and students.

Drive times:
-10 min to restaurants, grocery stores, & gas stations 
-20 min to airport (7.4 mi)
-20 min to Percy Priest Lake (8 mi)
-30 min to Downtown Nashville (16 mi)
-30 min to Grand Ole Opry (17 mi)

The space
This is a three bedroom townhouse with three floors, and each floor has its own private bedroom and bath.

This listing is for the third floor unit.

Guest access
Guests will have their own private room and bathroom and will share the kitchen and laundry room with one or two other guests (housemates) if and when the other rooms are booked.

During your stay
You can contact me directly.

Other things to note
There is a smart lock to get into the property with a unique code, and each bedroom has a separate unique physical lock and key
